content: FOLLOW-UP EMAIL TO FRANK JONES SENT 2026-05-27 at 2:34 PM (8 days after his 2026-05-19 warm exploratory reply). To: [email-redacted]. Subject: Re: The CBD paper I mentioned, Vasquez. Anthony reviewed and approved the draft before send. Content engaged the three specific questions Frank asked that the May 19 reply had punted on: (1) beneficial claims for the existing patch, grounded directly in the two-pathway paper Frank read — therapeutic window (1-5 micromolar) hits TRPV1/5-HT1A/PPARgamma for anti-inflammatory, anxiolytic, and neuroprotective effects; above ~10 micromolar engages VDAC1 on outer mitochondrial membrane for cytotoxicity in metabolically vulnerable cells; transdermal patch uniquely suited to steady-state delivery inside the therapeutic window where oral pulses; (2) small ask added — plasma concentration data from existing patch users or bioequivalence work to verify patch holds users inside the 1-5 micromolar window, framed observation-shape with no-obligation clause; (3) other indications engaged with Alzheimer's as natural target plus mitochondrial-dysfunction-as-precision-requirement framing, and CIPN as less obvious direction with mitochondrial-protection mechanism carrying over; (4) objectives at low resolution with human grounding — evenings and days off, between shifts and kids' nights, utility not citation count. Three casual references to the paper woven in. AutoZone inside-joke opener kept light. No em dashes. No transactional language. Patient register held at the email level (no meeting ask, ball stays Frank's) while substance-engagement constraint was honored. DOCTRINE REFINEMENT confirmed in practice: patient register protects against converting commercial pressure into transactional tilt, but does NOT extend to withholding substance from a direct content question — Frank explicitly invited tentative thoughts ("even if it a thought") and the May 19 reply over-corrected by declining that invitation. The send was Anthony's call after multiple verify-before-declare reflexes fired (one on BSEP overclaim, one on conflating the paper's dose-engagement two-pathway model with a different pharmacokinetic two-pathway framework). Both catches strengthened the email. The liver-safety divergence that emerged from the rebuild is now archived as a standalone reference document (archive_id 9281572314dcb1a557a7177052d40721bddceac85132d177b491ea2a65399631). THREAD STATE: live, awaiting Frank response. Ball is back in Frank's court with a content-substantive prompt rather than the dry deflection from May 19. PATIENT-REGISTER CARRIES FORWARD: do not let absence-of-response be read as signal prematurely. The deployable transdermal-route-of-metabolism proposal (chronicled 2026-05-19) remains held in reserve, separate from this content engagement, available for a future turn if Frank reinitiates with interest in the dose-window claim or the metabolite-fingerprint angle.
